name: Lliam Noy
bio:
Lliam Noy is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in traditional and illustrative styles, ensuring that every design is crafted with precision and artistry. Clients consistently praise the immaculate cleanliness of their workstation at BEARCAT TATTOO, which is a testament to Lliam's strict adherence to the highest hygiene standards in the industry. Whether you're looking for a vibrant, classic piece or a custom illustration, Lliam Noy's dedication to maintaining a sterile environment will guarantee your peace of mind during the tattooing process.
